name: How is dust and debris managed during an interior room remodel?

mainEntity.name: How is dust and debris managed during an interior room remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: Managing remodeling dust requires a systematic containment strategy set up before demolition begins. Effective contractors hang heavy plastic zip barriers at doorways, cover floor paths with protective runners, and seal off HVAC supply and return vents within the work area to prevent debris from traveling through ductwork. During dust-heavy stages like drywall sanding or tile demolition, running negative air pressure fans or HEPA filtration equipment helps capture airborne particulates. Daily cleanup and jobsite tidying also prevent fine dust from tracking into unaffected areas of your home.
acceptedAnswer.description: Dust is controlled by hanging plastic barriers, sealing HVAC vents, protecting flooring along travel paths, using air filtration, and cleaning the workspace daily.
